newsitem.title: USA: Warehouse retailer Price Costco posts gain.
newsitem.headline: Warehouse retailer Price Costco posts gain.

text.p: Retail warehouse giant Price Costco Inc. said Thursday its profits gained 21 percent in the latest quarter, boosted by accounting changes and stronger sales.
The company said it rang up fourth-quarter net income of $86.5 million, or 42 cents per share, versus $71.3 million, or 35 cents per share, in same period a year earlier.

For the full year, the company reported profits of $248.8 million, or $1.22 a share, versus $133.9 million, or 68 cents a share, a year ago. The year-ago figures reflect a charge of $83.4 million, or 37 cents a share, taken in the second quarter of fiscal 1995 for the spin-off of its Price Enterprises, Inc. unit.
The company operates 252 warehouse stores in the United States, Canada and Britain.

The company said earnings for the recent quarter were affected by two accounting changes -- a benefit of $7.5 million, compared with a charge of $2.0 million recorded in the year-ago period, and a separate $5.2 million charge.
Price Costco shares rose 37.5 cents to $21.125 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
